nodes.beczki.text.t: "Tar? People whisper that somebody made himself as many enemies in one go as another man does in a lifetime. I don't ask who. Just don't sit with your back to the door."

nodes.lad.options.[beczki].text.t: They say somebody poured all the tar into the river.

nodes.lad.options.[most_otwarty].text.t: The Bridge on the Grey is standing wide open, did you hear?

nodes.lad.options.[most_strzezony].text.t: Someone's guarding the Bridge on the Grey now.

nodes.lad.options.[most_zerwany].text.t: Heard about the Bridge on the Grey?

nodes.lad.text.t: Behind the counter a bald, mustachioed man polishes a tankard so long the tankard is starting to feel ashamed. Above him hangs a board with burned-in letters: "Hjalmar. No credit." "Didn't see a thing, didn't hear a thing, and a beer costs two groats. What'll it be, so we both have something to not talk about?"

nodes.miasto.text.t: "The city? The city's scared. The Emperor hasn't left the palace in a month, the Marshal presses into service anyone who can stand straight, and fewer and fewer can. Did you ask me? No. I didn't tell you." He tops you up with something that looks like beer and tastes like pickle brine.

nodes.most_otwarty.text.t: "Open's open. Both sides cross, and I only catch half of what's said, because they go quiet at the table when I walk in. Good sign. Means they're saying something interesting."

nodes.most_strzezony.text.t: "Guarded? That's unheard of. Round here a bridge gets guarded until somebody pays you not to. Pity I don't know the man standing there. Maybe he'd haul my wine someday."

nodes.most_zerwany.text.t: "Broken? Ah, that bridge. They say the ferryman made a fortune off it: one day and it already pays him to stay up nights. I know nothing, but the merchants from the north stopped coming and the beer got dearer. A coincidence, as the people who write the bills say."

nodes.powrot.options.[beczki].text.t: They say somebody poured all the tar into the river.

nodes.powrot.options.[most_otwarty].text.t: The Bridge on the Grey is standing wide open, did you hear?

nodes.powrot.options.[most_strzezony].te.t: Someone's guarding the Bridge on the Grey now.

nodes.powrot.options.[most_zerwany].text.t: Heard about the Bridge on the Grey?

nodes.powrot.text.t: Hjalmar doesn't stop polishing the tankard, but he nods in a way that shows he remembers who was here last time. "You again, sir. Let me guess, I still didn't see a thing, and a beer still costs two groats."

nodes.szukam.text.t: The innkeeper doesn't look up from the tankard, just points his chin at the board over his head. "You're looking, and you're standing in front of him. Hjalmar, twenty years now, and in all that time nobody's come looking for me with good news. If you want to know what's going on in the city, ask. I'll tell you I know nothing, only at greater length."
